features.label: Bytes sent
features.description: Bytes sent from source to destination.

features.label: Bytes received
features.description: Bytes sent back from destination to source.

features.label: Host connections (2s)
features.description: Connections to the same destination host in the last 2 seconds.

features.label: Service connections (2s)
features.description: Connections to the same destination service in the last 2 seconds.

features.label: SYN error rate
features.description: Fraction of recent connections to this host that were half-open (SYN error).

features.label: Same-service rate
features.description: Fraction of recent connections to this host using the same service.

features.label: Host connections (window)
features.description: Connections to this destination host over a longer historical window.

features.label: Host+service connections (window)
features.description: Connections to this destination host and service over that same window.

features.label: Error/incomplete flag
features.description: Whether the connection ended in an error or incomplete state instead of closing cleanly.
features.lockedReason: This falls out of the attack mechanism itself, for example a half-open scan produces it by construction. Changing it usually means abandoning the technique, not evading it.

features.label: Authenticated
features.lockedReason: Faking a successful login means actually compromising valid credentials, which is a separate problem from anything else in this flow record.

features.label: Recognized service
features.description: Whether the destination is a recognized, well-known service rather than an unclassified high port.
features.lockedReason: This identifies which service is being targeted. Changing it means attacking a different service, not evading detection on this one.
